architecture_assessment: After version/licence resolution, an isolated R process/service is a technical candidate behind ArborScan HTTP boundary; Linux portability remains untested.

Independent Python implementation from openly described science requires explicit source and coefficient provenance, supported applicability domains, unit/reference cases and independent validation; translation of licensed R code is not automatically a separate unrestricted implementation.
Legacy Windows32 desktop file exchange is documented, but old purchased licence and network/public-service rights must be checked before deploying as backend.
Online portal is not a verified API and should not be assumed a stable computational dependency.
